content.text: Governing law and forum both sit at the preferred position, with no competing arbitration clause anywhere in the document.

input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28 meets the preferred position in full: § 28.1 selects New York law, and § 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County, New York exclusive jurisdiction with submission to personal jurisdiction and a venue/forum-inconvenience waiver. Searches for "arbitration", "laws of" and "courts" return no other governing-law or forum provision, so there is no offshore arbitration seat or competing foreign venue. The pre-filing executive escalation in § 28.3 is a fifteen-business-day good-faith meeting that expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, and there is no fee-shifting, so it does not displace the court forum. No redline required.
